Weeknight Lentil Soup

Yield: 4 servings

Ingredients
- 1 cup dried brown lentils
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 carrots
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1 teaspoon kosher salt

Preparation
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for about 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the cumin and salt. Add the lentils and the broth, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Simmer 30 minutes, covered, until tender.
